title: Land Cruiser 250 Series
verdict: Toyota took the Land Cruiser away from America, thought about it for a few years, and brought back a Prado in a 1980s costume, which turns out to be exactly what most of us wanted. It's smaller, cheaper and boxier than the truck it replaced, and it comes with lockers as standard. The one thing it doesn't come with is a big fuel tank.

paragraphs: In December 2020 Toyota confirmed that the Land Cruiser would leave North America after the 2021 model year, ending the run of the V8 [[land-cruiser/200-series|200 Series]]. The gap lasted two model years. On 2 August 2023 Toyota unveiled the J250. Most of the world knows it as the fifth-generation Land Cruiser Prado, but in the US it is sold simply as the Land Cruiser. It is a two-row midsize SUV rather than a three-row full-size one, it is boxier, and it starts at a much lower price than the 200 did. In North America it comes only as a hybrid. The full-size flagship, the [[land-cruiser/300-series|300 Series]], still isn't sold here.

story.heading: A PRADO BY ANY OTHER NAME
paragraphs: Americans have owned Prados for years without being told. The previous J150 Prado was sold in the US as the [[lexus/gx460|Lexus GX 460]], and the J250 has a Lexus twin of its own in the [[lexus/gx550|GX 550]], which uses a 349-hp twin-turbo V6. This time the Toyota-badged truck came too. It sits on the GA-F body-on-frame platform shared with the 300 Series. Toyota claims frame rigidity is up 50 percent and overall rigidity 30 percent, and the 250 is the first 'light-duty' Land Cruiser with electric power steering, which is what makes lane-tracing assist possible.

Outside the US the engine list is long. Depending on the market, the 250 is offered with a 2.4-liter turbo petrol, a 2.7-liter petrol four, the familiar 2.8-liter 1GD-FTV turbo-diesel, or that diesel with a 48-volt mild-hybrid system, which is what Australia and Western Europe get. Europe mostly calls it plain 'Land Cruiser' and keeps the Prado name only where the 300 is also sold. The US and China get the gasoline hybrid only. Every version is a four-cylinder.

story.heading: BACK TO THE BOX
paragraphs: Wikipedia credits project chief designer Yoshito Watanabe's team with returning to practicality, durability and dependability, following a basic direction set by former Toyota CEO Akio Toyoda. They also made it look like a 1980s Land Cruiser again. The square body draws on the [[land-cruiser/60-series|60 Series]]. The base '1958' grade and the launch First Edition get round LED headlamps behind a TOYOTA heritage grille, and the mid-grade 'Land Cruiser' uses rectangular lamps that Toyota says were modeled on the FJ62. Toyota also pushed the A-pillars back and lowered the beltline so you can see the trail over the hood.

The US launched with three grades: the 1958 at $55,950 before a $1,395 dealer fee, the Land Cruiser, and a First Edition limited to 5,000 trucks for North America. The First Edition came with a roof rack, rock rails and a front skid plate. Car and Driver's First Edition test car reached 60 mph in 7.7 seconds. The magazine's staff liked the slimmer size and the 40- and 80-series design cues. They complained about the thin sheet metal and doors you have to slam.

story.heading: THE HYBRID IN THE ROOM
paragraphs: The US powertrain is the i-FORCE MAX: a 2.4-liter turbocharged four with a 48-hp electric motor in the bell housing of an eight-speed automatic, for 326 hp and 465 lb-ft. The hybrid battery is a 1.87 kWh nickel-metal-hydride pack. The EPA rates it at 22 city, 25 highway and 23 combined, compared with 14 combined for the last V8 200, and Car and Driver averaged 20 mpg over its test. Full-time four-wheel drive with a two-speed transfer case is standard, and so are locking center and rear differentials on every US grade.

The catch is the fuel tank. It holds 17.9 gallons, and with the mileage above, overlanders start looking at the fuel gauge sooner than they would like. Slee Off-Road's Arctic Trucks build swaps in a 29-gallon tank, which is more than 50 percent more. Owners also note that the battery's location gives the cargo area a sloped floor. On long, steep descents, several owners on LandCruiserForum.com report brake fade from relying on Downhill Assist alone. One measured his rotors at 575°F at the Pikes Peak brake check.

story.heading: SO FAR, SO TOYOTA
paragraphs: Americans bought it. Wikipedia counts 29,113 US sales in 2024 and 43,946 in 2025. With the First Edition gone, Toyota's 2027 line-up is two grades: the 1958 at $58,180 and the Land Cruiser at $64,255 (base MSRP, per Toyota). New options are an 'Inked' paint color and a $980 raised air intake, which Motor1 is careful to point out is not a watertight snorkel.

The recall list so far is mostly software and paperwork: an instrument-cluster update for displays that can go blank at start-up, a corrected load-capacity label, a rear-camera fix, and an interim notice in 2026 for a fuel-pipe connector that can come loose. None of it is the kind of mechanical horror story that gets a truck a reputation, though it also isn't the 'never needs anything' legend some buyers expect. Notably, the US 250 doesn't use the V35A twin-turbo V6 whose bearing recalls have affected the Lexus LX, Tundra and some 2024 GX 550s.

callout.label: SIDEBAR · THE WALRUS
callout.title: The 250 on 37s, done properly
paragraphs: Slee Off-Road and Arctic Trucks North America built what they describe as the first US-spec Land Cruiser 250 AT37, nicknamed 'The Walrus'. It isn't just a lift. Arctic Trucks enlarges the wheel wells and moves the rear axle, which extends the wheelbase, so 37-inch BFGoodrich KO3s fit at full compression on a minimal lift.

Slee lists 11 inches of front wheel travel (2 more than stock) and 12 inches at the rear (3 more), from three-way-adjustable R53/AT dampers. The truck also gets 4.56 gears, an ARB front Air Locker to go with the factory rear locker, Slee aluminum skids and SliderSteps, and a 29-gallon fuel tank in place of the stock 17.9. It's the most complete answer anyone has given to the 250's two weak points: tire clearance and range.

engineering_intro: Under the retro bodywork is a modern Toyota truck: a ladder frame on the GA-F platform it shares with the 300 Series and the Lexus GX 550, an independent front end with a coil-sprung solid rear axle, and a full-time four-wheel-drive system. In US trucks that's paired with a 2.4-liter turbo-hybrid and lockers as standard. The wheelbase is 112.2 inches, the same figure the 80 Series introduced.

engineering.note: Toyota claims frame rigidity up 50% and overall rigidity up 30% over the previous Prado.

engineering.v: Full-time, Torsen center diff with lock, 2-speed transfer
engineering.note: Electronically shifted high and low range; normal torque split is 40/60 front to rear.
The rear locker can split power 50/50 across the axle. No factory front locker.
326 hp and 465 lb-ft combined; 1.87 kWh, 288 V NiMH hybrid battery.

engineering.v: Independent front, coil-sprung live rear axle
engineering.note: A Stabilizer Disconnect Mechanism (SDM) for more articulation is available on the Land Cruiser grade and was fitted to the First Edition.

engineering.v: Electric power steering; CRAWL, Multi-Terrain Select
engineering.note: First light-duty Land Cruiser with EPS. CRAWL Control has five speeds; Multi-Terrain Select works in 4HI and 4LO.

generations_table.note: i-FORCE MAX, 8-speed auto. The only US powertrain.
Non-hybrid turbo four with an 8-speed auto.
8-speed auto. The only engine in Australian 250s.
Same GA-F platform; the US-market V6 alternative.

buying_checks.head: Know which grade you're looking at
buying_checks.body: The 1958 has round lamps, cloth seats, 245/70R18 tires on 18x7.5 wheels and no stabilizer disconnect. The Land Cruiser grade has rectangular lamps, 265/70R18 tires, and SDM availability. The 2024 First Edition (5,000 built for North America) keeps the round lamps and adds rock rails, a front skid and a roof rack. Premium Package trucks ride on 20-inch wheels with 265/60R20 tires.

buying_checks.head: Run the VIN for recalls
buying_checks.body: Campaigns so far include an instrument-cluster software update for displays that can go blank (about 82,000 Toyota and Lexus vehicles, announced May 2026), a corrected load-capacity label on certain 2024–2025 hybrids, a rear-camera software fix, and an interim notice (26TA23) for a fuel-pipe connector that can disconnect. Check NHTSA or the Toyota app.

buying_checks.head: Listen for squeal in reverse
buying_checks.body: Front-brake squeal when backing up is covered by TSB T-SB-0006-26, which supersedes T-SB-0046-25 and replaces pads and shims after a technician confirms the problem. Owners say you can tell it's been done from the newer anti-rattle springs on the caliper.

buying_checks.head: Check the hybrid-battery vents
buying_checks.body: The cooling intakes look like speaker grilles in the lower side trim at the rear door opening. Make sure nothing is blocking them. Owners have found cargo and even a plastic bag over them, and several trucks threw battery cooling-fan maintenance warnings at low mileage that dealers cleared.

buying_checks.head: Test the 12 V battery
buying_checks.body: Owners on LandCruiserForum.com report no-starts after leaving doors or the hatch open for a few minutes at camp. Have the 12 V battery load-tested and ask whether it has been replaced.

buying_checks.head: Look underneath
buying_checks.body: On used trucks, pull the front skid plate. Owners report stripped skid-plate bolt threads from repeated oil changes. Look for trail damage, and check whether any lift kit came with an alignment.

buying_checks.head: Ask for diff and transfer-case service records
buying_checks.body: The owner's manual calls for 75W-85 GL-5 in the differentials, and owners report the dealer parts counter doesn't always stock it. Ask what was used.

buying_checks.head: Do the range math
buying_checks.body: A 17.9-gallon tank at the EPA's 23 mpg combined is about 410 miles in theory, and less with bigger tires, a roof rack or a trailer. If you travel remote, budget for jerry cans or an aftermarket long-range tank.

repairs.title: Engine oil and filter change
repairs.symptoms: Scheduled service. Many owners also change the factory oil early, at around 1,000–1,500 miles.
repairs.fix: Warm the engine, then remove the front skid plate. Owners call it easy, but check the bolts, since some threads have been damaged. Drain the oil, replace the filter, refit the drain plug with a new gasket, and fill with 0W-20. Owners on LandCruiserForum.com report a capacity of about 5.9 quarts. Confirm it against your owner's manual and check the dipstick before refitting the skid. A Fumoto-style drain valve with a hose makes later changes cleaner, though the pan won't drain completely either way.
repairs.tools: Socket set · drain pan · filter wrench · 0W-20 oil · OEM filter 90915-10009 (as reported by an owner) · new drain-plug gasket · optional Fumoto valve.

repairs.title: Differential and transfer-case fluid
repairs.symptoms: Scheduled service, or after deep water crossings or heavy towing.
repairs.fix: Remove the skid plate if needed. On each unit, loosen the fill plug first so you know you can refill, then drain, refit the drain plug and fill until fluid reaches the bottom of the fill hole. The manual calls for 75W-85 GL-5 gear oil in the differentials and Toyota 75W 'LF' in the transfer case. Toyota dealers don't always stock either, so owners have used Amsoil 75W-85 in the diffs and Red Line MT-LV in the transfer case. Keep your receipts in case of a warranty claim.
repairs.tools: Socket set · fluid pump · drain pan · 75W-85 GL-5 gear oil · 75W transfer-case fluid · new plug gaskets.

parts.name: Red Line MT-LV 70W75W (owner-used in the transfer case)

repairs.title: Fix front-brake squeal in reverse
repairs.symptoms: Squealing from the front brakes when backing up, especially at low speed.
repairs.fix: Under warranty, ask the dealer for T-SB-0006-26 (pads and shims; it replaced T-SB-0046-25). Owners report rotors aren't part of the fix. One owner fixed it himself by fitting the revised anti-rattle springs from the TSB on both the lower and upper pins and greasing the pad contact points. He didn't replace pads or rotors, and he says the squeak is completely gone.
repairs.tools: Basic hand tools · brake grease · TSB anti-rattle springs (and pads/shims if following the full TSB).

repairs.title: Clear the hybrid-battery cooling intakes
repairs.symptoms: A 'battery cooling fan maintenance' message, or a fan running louder than usual.
repairs.fix: Open the rear door and find the grille-like intakes low in the side trim on each side. Remove anything blocking them, such as bags, gear or dust, and keep cargo clear of them. If the warning keeps coming back on a low-mileage truck with clean vents, have the dealer scan it. One dealer cleared a reminder it believed had been set at 5,000 miles instead of 50,000 at the factory.
repairs.tools: Vacuum · trim tool if removing covers.

repairs.title: Keep the 12 V battery alive at camp
repairs.symptoms: The truck won't go into Ready after the doors or hatch have been open for a while with the engine off.
repairs.fix: Load-test the 12 V battery and replace it if it's weak. Owners recommend carrying a lithium jump pack, fitting a Bluetooth battery monitor (the Ancel BM300 and BM200 Pro have been mentioned) to watch state of charge, or starting the hybrid system before a long unloading stop. One owner warns that a big aftermarket AGM may sit at a partial charge, because the hybrid system doesn't fully top it off.
repairs.tools: Battery tester · jump pack · battery monitor · 10 mm wrench.

parts.name: ANCEL Bluetooth battery monitors (BM200 Pro / BM300)

repairs.title: Make room for 35s
repairs.symptoms: Rubbing at full lock or compression after fitting tires over about 33 inches.
repairs.fix: Threepiece's fitment guide: remove the mud flaps, crush brackets and canards (they bolt or clip on and can go back later). Invert and heat-form the plastic fender liners. If you still need room, radius the back of the front fenders or trim a few inches from the front bumper. Offset matters: the guide says zero-offset wheels with the same tires didn't fit, and it suggests a 17x8 +25 for 35s on a stock-height 1958. Get an alignment afterwards.
repairs.tools: Socket set · trim tools · heat gun · cutting tool · 17-inch or 18-inch wheels with the right offset (6x139.7, 95.1 mm bore, M14x1.5 lugs).

parts.name: LC250 / GX550 wheel & tire fitment guide (offsets that work)

faq.q: What's the biggest tire I can fit without a lift?
faq.a: Threepiece's fitment guide puts the no-modification limit at about 31.5 inches on the 1958 and 32.6 inches on the wider-wheeled grades. Owners go a bit bigger: 275/70R18s (about 33 inches) on stock 1958 wheels, and 285/70R18s (about 33.7 inches) on stock suspension, including one owner on 18x9 +40 wheels who reported no rubbing on gentle trails. An LT275/70R18 KO3 (33.2 inches) just fits in the spare well. 35s are possible on stock suspension, but only after removing the mud flaps and doing some trimming.

6,000 lb, according to Toyota, and the 1958 grade comes with a trailer brake controller. Owners note that a small engine doesn't give much engine braking, so on long grades use the transmission and low range rather than the service brakes alone.

faq.q: What fuel economy and range should I expect?
faq.a: The EPA rates it at 22 city, 25 highway and 23 combined. Car and Driver averaged 20 mpg, and Flexmotor saw about 21 off-road and 24 on the highway. The tank holds 17.9 gallons, which is why long-range tanks and jerry cans are popular.
Every US grade has a locking center differential and an electronic locking rear differential. There's no factory front locker. Slee's AT37 build added an ARB Air Locker up front.

faq.q: Why only a four-cylinder hybrid? Can I get the diesel?
faq.a: North America and China only get the 2.4-liter i-FORCE MAX hybrid. The 2.8-liter diesel, the 2.7 petrol and the non-hybrid 2.4 turbo are sold elsewhere. If you want a V6 on this platform in the US, the Lexus GX 550 has a 349-hp 3.4-liter twin-turbo.

faq.q: Is it a 'real' Land Cruiser or just a Prado?
faq.a: It's a Prado, and the Prado has always been a real Land Cruiser: ladder frame, live rear axle, full-time 4WD with low range. It shares the GA-F platform with the 300 Series, and its 112.2-inch wheelbase is the same figure the 80 Series introduced. It's smaller than the 200 Series it replaced in the US and seats two rows, not three.

faq.q: Which grade should I buy for off-road use?
faq.a: The 1958 is the cheapest way into center and rear lockers, but it doesn't offer the Stabilizer Disconnect Mechanism, which gives the front axle more articulation. The Land Cruiser grade (and the 2024 First Edition) can have SDM and comes on wider 265/70R18 tires. For 2027 the 1958 starts at $58,180 and the Land Cruiser at $64,255 (base MSRP).

faq.q: What oil and fluids does it take?
faq.a: 0W-20 engine oil (owners report about 5.9 quarts with the filter), 75W-85 GL-5 in the differentials according to the manual, and Toyota 75W 'LF' in the transfer case. Check the owner's manual for your truck's exact figures.

ICON sells 1.25–3 inch systems for the 250, Dobinsons offers a 2-inch kit, and Slee's dealer build used an ADS 2.5-inch system. Threepiece tested a 1.5-inch Tuff Country leveling kit with 285/70R17s and reported no rubbing.

faq.q: Is the new raised air intake a snorkel?
faq.a: No. The $980 factory raised intake offered for 2027 isn't watertight, so Motor1 notes it doesn't improve wading the way a sealed snorkel would. It helps with dust.

It's early days. Recalls so far are an instrument-cluster software update, a corrected load-capacity label, a rear-camera fix, and an interim fuel-pipe connector notice. Common owner complaints are front-brake squeal in reverse (fixed by a TSB), 12 V battery drain, and hybrid-battery fan warnings. The US 250 doesn't use the V35A V6 involved in the LX and Tundra bearing recalls.

mods.why: A 1.25–3 inch lift with better dampers clears 33s easily and 35s with some trimming, and it handles the weight of armor and gear.
The 250 is long and low between the axles. Frame-mounted sliders and a proper front skid protect the rockers and the radiator area.
A winch bumper gives you recovery points and a place for a winch. Slee says its LC250 bumper keeps the Safety Sense sensors working (except front cross-traffic).

who.name: Dissent Off-Road — LC250 modular winch bumper

mods.why: 17.9 gallons is the 250's biggest limit for remote travel. The tank on Slee's AT37 build holds 29 gallons and has an integrated skid.
Center and rear lockers come standard. Adding a front locker gives you all three, which only the top 300 Series and LX trims get from the factory.
If you'd rather buy it done, Slee builds complete LC250s, from bolt-on dealer packages to the Arctic Trucks AT37 conversion.

baseline_service.intro: Even a low-mileage 250 is worth baselining. Many owners change the factory oil early, and the diff and transfer fluids are rarely touched under the 'inspect only' schedule. Specs below are from Toyota's US 2024 Land Cruiser Owner's Manual (OM60U35U) and its Warranty & Maintenance Guide for the i-FORCE MAX hybrid (T24A-FTS).

items.spec: ILSAC GF-6A SAE 0W-20 (5W-20 only as a stopgap) · 5.9 qt with filter
items.interval: Then every 10,000 mi / 12 months; 5,000 mi for dusty or towing use (Toyota)
items.note: Remove the front skid plate. Check the level with the hybrid system off after about 5 minutes. Many owners do the first change early, at 1,000–1,500 mi.

items.interval: Replace every 30,000 mi; inspect more often on dirt roads (Toyota)

items.spec: Vacuum-clean the filter behind the cargo-area side vents
items.interval: Inspect every 5,000 mi, clean every 20,000 mi (Toyota)
items.note: The Owner's Manual walks through the cleaning. If the filter is damaged, have the dealer replace it. Keep cargo off the vents.

items.spec: NGK DILZKAR8E7H iridium · 0.028 in (0.7 mm) gap, do not adjust
items.note: That interval is short because the engine is turbocharged. Don't assume a V8-style 120k plug life.

items.spec: Toyota Super Long Life Coolant or equivalent · engine 12.2 qt (14.3 qt with rear A/C), power control unit 2.5 qt
items.interval: Intercooler coolant first at 150,000 mi, then every 50,000 mi; engine/inverter coolant is inspected (Toyota)
items.note: There are three separate cooling loops. Check each reservoir level.

items.spec: Toyota Genuine ATF WS · 13.2 qt reference capacity
items.interval: Replace at 60,000 mi when towing or heavily loaded, or with lots of idling (Toyota); otherwise inspect
items.note: The manual warns that non-WS fluid can cause noise or damage. The level is checked by temperature (no dipstick), so most owners leave this to a dealer.

items.spec: Toyota Genuine Transfer Gear Oil LF, SAE 75W · 1.48 qt
items.interval: Every 30,000 mi when driving on dirt or towing (Toyota); otherwise inspect
items.note: Dealers don't always stock LF. Owners have used Red Line MT-LV. Keep receipts for warranty.

items.spec: Toyota Genuine Differential Gear Oil LT 75W-85 GL-5 · front 1.29 qt, rear 5.94 qt
items.interval: Front every 15,000 mi and both at 30,000 mi when towing or heavily loaded (Toyota); otherwise inspect
items.note: The rear locker is standard in the US. Loosen the fill plug before you drain.

items.spec: Lithium chassis grease NLGI 2 on the spiders; moly-lithium or lithium NLGI 2 on the front slide yoke
items.interval: Lubricate and re-torque the propeller-shaft bolts every 15,000 mi (Toyota)
Inspect (Toyota); flush if the history is unknown

items.spec: 12.0 V or higher open voltage (Toyota test: power off, high beams on for 30 s first)
items.note: A weak 12 V battery stops the hybrid system going to Ready. See the repair above.

items.interval: Inspect at 60,000 mi, then every 15,000 mi (Toyota)
